# ADR-3083: A07: Documented service-account password for legacy batch 11

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Some mainframe jobs still need passwords.

## Decision

Legacy batches MAY adopt a documented service-account password for legacy batch 11 (A07-11) when modern federation is unavailable.

## Consequences

Passwords rotate and are vaulted.
